text: On small devices, memory decides which AI
Quantized formats spend the same bits on
every weight code, even though some codes
are far more common than others.
LazyWeights compresses those codes losslessly and decodes
them on demand between memory and cache,
smaller than the best llama.cpp formats.
A tiny decoder chip cut latency and
energy per token by up to 36
and 38 percent on an Orin board.
Compression in hardware could bring bigger models
